scenario_stem:
Hartham Bakery is a family-run private limited company founded in 2003 in the market town of Bramfield. It employs 24 bakers, shop assistants and delivery drivers, producing artisan loaves and cakes for 3 retail outlets across Country X, and generated $520,000 in annual sales revenue last year. The owner, Priya Raman, plans to replace the retiring production supervisor who has managed the bakery floor for 9 years.

Priya has a recruitment budget of $4,500 and wants the new supervisor in post within 8 weeks. Two internal candidates, both senior bakers with 6 and 4 years at the bakery, have expressed interest, while an experienced supervisor from a rival bakery has also applied after Priya placed a small advert in the local newspaper. Priya must decide whether to promote internally or appoint the external candidate.

Reason 2: Job analysis ensures the advert and selection criteria match the role [k], so Priya attracts suitable candidates within the $4,500 recruitment budget rather than wasting money on unsuitable applicants [app].

Job analysis ensures the advert and criteria match the role
application_max_2: Managing the bakery floor and 24 staff across 3 retail outlets

Benefit 2: A job description gives the interviewer a checklist for comparing candidates [k], allowing internal and external applicants to be scored against the same duties [app], making the final choice more objective and lowering the risk of a poor appointment [an].

However, appointing externally overlooks the 2 internal candidates with 6 and 4 years at the bakery [k], who already know the 24 staff, the 3 retail outlets and Priya's plans [app], so promotion could boost morale and loyalty across the workforce [an]. scenario_stem:
Norwick Bridge Engineering Ltd is a private limited company that maintains steel bridges and viaducts across Country X. Founded in 1998, it employs 58 engineers and maintenance crews, and last year completed 14 refurbishment contracts worth $1.6 million in total revenue. The managing director, Tomasz Nowak, needs 2 graduate civil engineers to join the inspection team next year.

The inspection team requires graduates who can read technical drawings, operate measurement equipment and write safety reports. Tomasz has drawn up a person specification listing the qualifications, skills, experience and personal qualities sought. scenario_stem:

Founded in 2012, it employs 22 pharmacists and dispensing technicians, serving about 1,100 customers every week. With 2 pharmacists retiring in June, Dr. Marsh needs to recruit 2 qualified pharmacists urgently and has a recruitment budget of $6,000.

She is deciding how to advertise the vacancies. National pharmacy press adverts cost $2,400 each and would reach candidates across the whole country, while a free online job site cost nothing but produced only 5 weak applications last year. scenario_stem:
The Corvane Grand Hotel is a 4-star hotel with 110 guest rooms in the coastal resort town of Port Aurel, Country X. Founded in 2007, it employs 74 staff, including 19 in the kitchen, and generated $1.9 million in room and food revenue last year. The head chef, Marco Deluca, has resigned with 3 weeks' notice, leaving the kitchen understaffed ahead of the busiest season.

The general manager, Sandra Iwu, plans to recruit a new head chef and a commis chef before the $240,000 of wedding bookings in July. She intends to carry out a job analysis first, working with the existing kitchen staff to identify the tasks, skills and working conditions involved. She has $3,000 for recruitment and wants both chefs in post within 6 weeks.

Reason 2: It produces accurate adverts and selection criteria [k], so candidates know the work involved before the $240,000 July wedding bookings begin [app].

scenario_stem:
Brackmoor Haulage Ltd is a private limited company operating a distribution depot in the industrial city of Varenne, Country X. Founded in 2005, it employs 63 drivers, pickers and depot staff, running 28 lorries on contract delivery routes, and last year handled 42,000 pallets worth $2.3 million in revenue. Its operations manager resigned suddenly in March.

The managing director, Elena Petrova, must recruit a replacement urgently. She could promote Dani Whitmore, the shift supervisor with 7 years at the depot, who knows all 28 routes and the 42,000-pallet contract intimately. Promoting Dani would cost little and take only 2 weeks, though she has never managed a depot budget. Alternatively, Elena could advertise externally at a cost of $5,500. Dani earns $34,000 now; the manager role pays $48,000.

scenario_stem:

Founded in 1995, it employs 240 call handlers and team leaders answering about 18,000 calls a month for car and home insurance policies. The HR manager, Jonas Lindqvist, has shortlisted 30 candidates from 190 applications received in May. He plans to interview each shortlisted candidate for 20 minutes before 2 managers, at a cost of about $60 in manager time per interview, making roughly $1,800 in total. Alternatively, he could add a practical telephone-simulation assessment day costing $2,400, where candidates handle scripted calls scored by supervisors.
